# BVD Security d.o.o.

> Professional security and bodyguard services in Croatia.

## Core Services
- Bodyguard & Close Protection: High-profile and low-profile persona.
- Event Security: Public and private event management.
- Asset Protection: Industrial and residential security.
- Technical Security: Surveillance and access control.

## Credentials
- Licensed by the Ministry of the Interior (MUP RH).
- Operates under the Private Protection Act of Croatia.
- 24/7 Availability.
